waypoints.name: North Mount Elbert Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From US 24 about 3.5 miles south of Leadville, turn west on Colorado 300 and drive 0.7 mile, turn left onto Lake County Road 11 for 1.2 miles, then turn right onto Halfmoon Creek Road. Follow the dirt road about 5 miles to the North Mount Elbert Trailhead on the left at about 10,040 ft. The parking area fills early on weekends.

waypoints.name: Mount Elbert
waypoints.directions: Hike south to join the Colorado Trail, cross a footbridge and switchback through forest for about a mile, then turn right onto the North Mount Elbert Trail. Follow it to treeline near 11,900 ft and climb the northeast ridge, which steepens and turns rocky above 13,400 ft, to the flat crest near 13,900 ft and on southwest to the summit. On descent, stay on this ridge trail rather than the East Ridge trail.
